title: Literature Distill Request 1.0
description: Payload contract for lit_distill (plan §5.3). The agent/LLM produces the distilled content; deterministic code verifies every evidence-bearing field's quote against the cached literature text before storing a candidate entry.

source_id.description: Cached literature id from lit_search, e.g. openalex:W123 or arxiv:2412.34567.

content.description: Keys are per-type content sub-fields (see knowledge-entry-v1). Each value is either an evidence object or the string "evidence_gap".

text.description: Distilled field body (list form only for list fields such as testable_predictions).

quote.description: Verbatim passage (<=40 words) copied from the cached source text; must hit the cached text after case/whitespace normalization.

location.description: Where the quote sits, e.g. "abstract" or "paragraph 2".

evidence_gap.description: Why the source cannot support this field. Required content fields may not be gaps.
